rows.title: The high-risk plants set's rulings records carry the decisions now in force
rows.detail: The plants set keeps its rulings in one ledger, and every entry of its conflicts register and every behaviour of its journey specification points at that ledger rather than holding an answer of its own. Decisions taken since the set's own sittings change plants behaviours that earlier ledger entries settled, and not one of them is in the ledger, so the set's own record reads the opposite of what is being built. The first such decision is that the plants notification view header offers Copy as new, which replaces the ledger's park of reusing a previous consignment and the clause that left Copy as new out of the post-submission actions. Bringing the ledger and the register up to date by the set's own change procedure gives every later plants change one place to record its ruling.
acceptanceCriteria: A decision that changes a high-risk plants behaviour an earlier ledger entry settled is held in the set's decisions ledger as a new numbered entry whose status reads current, naming who decided it, the date it was decided and the entry it supersedes (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/panel/README.md:25-35; src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/decisions.json)

The decisions ledger holds a current entry recording that the plants notification view header offers Amend this notification, Copy as new and Delete, each posting its own form, with Copy as new carrying the notification's own plants answers into a new draft; it names the 25 November decision and who made it, and supersedes the entry that parked reusing a previous consignment (ruling:ian-2026-11-25b c-447; repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/decisions.json)

The ledger's entry for the post-submission action set keeps its list actions, the read-only view's Delete and Cancel amendment and the confirmation page's block on how to view or amend the notification, and a current entry superseding its Copy as new clause says Copy as new is offered on the plants notification view header (ruling:ian-2026-11-25b c-447; repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/decisions.json d-062)

Each ledger entry one of those decisions replaces stays in the ledger with its status reading superseded and names the entry that replaced it (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/decisions.json:136-138)

Each subject one of those entries settles reads the resolution now in force: a conflict carries that resolution, who resolved it and the new entry's number, and a behaviour carries its status, the new entry's number and the resolution appended to its detail (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/panel/README.md:25-35)

Each entry of the set's conflicts register whose disagreement one of those decisions settles points at that decision's ledger entry for the answer, and reads that entry's resolution and who made it (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/conflicts.json; src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/panel/README.md:5-6)

The conflicts register's entries on the contact section list as their fields only the obligations the journey has, matching what their resolutions say was taken off them (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/conflicts.json c-011, c-025)

The set's review-panel dockets, rulings, reconciliation entries and critic entries carry the arguments they already carry, and the ledger and its subjects are the only records a changed ruling rewrites (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/panel/README.md:25-35)

Check that the later plants rows recorded their own rulings the same way.
rows.notes: Existing row inc-277 kept unchanged on this re-distil: its requirements (req-2481, req-2483) and conflicts (c-447, c-448, c-449) read as they did. Combines the ledger slice (req-2481) with the conflicts register slice (req-2483): the register holds no answer of its own, only a pointer at the ledger, so a register entry cannot be written without its ledger entry. c-447 adds the Copy as new ledger entry: it supersedes the park of reusing a previous consignment, and only the Copy as new clause of d-062 gives way, by a new superseding entry, since the rest of d-062 stands. The Copy as new behaviour itself is built by the manage-notifications split theme, so this row records it once that row lands: keep externalDependsOn shared/design-release-2-1/themes/manage-notifications inc-123. c-448 is settled by precedence: the deleted plants journey spec ruling is not restored and nothing records its removal. c-449 is settled by precedence: every plants picker pages at eight and keeps the restatement of the chosen address, which the set's records already describe, so the pickers need no ledger entry. The c-011 and c-025 field-list criterion comes from req-2483's delta (repo-plantsfrontend-p16-120-m1). Re-stamping a behaviour subject edits the journey specification, which the specification row also rewrites, so this row builds first. Stands alone from the specification row: merged they would carry over 20 criteria.

rows.title: The high-risk plants journey specification says what the set now has
rows.detail: The specification is the plants set's contract and the tests linked to its scenarios are its evidence, so an entry that reads the old way makes the contract false and points its evidence at behaviour nobody has. It states the journey as it stood before this programme: the overview, the page order, the pickers, the notification list and the status strip as they were, and a read-only view with no Copy as new. Several entries describe finished work as unfinished, an empty fixture sits beside it seeding nothing, and it disagrees with itself or the code on the copied banner, the address book link, the Ministry of Justice Frontend version and how the consignor is stored. It also covers none of the amend, cancel amendment, delete notification and party edit pages the service serves. Putting each entry right makes the contract true.
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the specification's seven sources is recorded as extracted (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/journey-spec.json:10, 17, 24, 31, 38, 45, 52)

The specification records the journey's end-to-end walkthrough fixture as in place, and names the consignment it opens with: ware potatoes from Spain notified before arrival (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/journey-spec.json:240; src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/journeys/linear/flow/fixtures/happy-path.json:2-3)

The specification records the set's table of contract tests as in place, pinning that each collecting page's valid save commits exactly the answers that page collects (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/journey-spec.json:222)

The specification's entry for the set's unused services records their removal as the settled outcome, for the import reason and purpose, the transport reference and the commercial transporter (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/journey-spec.json:367)

The set keeps one end-to-end walkthrough fixture for the journey, held with the journey's flow, and the specification names it as where the walkthrough starts (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/fixtures/happy-path.json:1)

The specification's notification view entry records a header offering Amend this notification, Copy as new and Delete, each posting its own form, and its post-submission actions behaviour records Copy as new on that header with the notification list's banner after a copy (ruling:ian-2026-11-25b c-447; repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/journey-spec.json:154, 435, 1042)

The specification's layout chrome links Address book to the service's address book, as the layout does (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/journey-spec.json:172; src/server/app/shared/layout.njk:38-39)

The specification names one Ministry of Justice Frontend version, the one the set depends on, in both its layout chrome and its toolbox rule (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/journey-spec.json:172, 361; package.json:75)

The consignor obligation's storage entry and the ledger state the same storage for the chosen consignor, the one the service keeps (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/journey-spec.json:2305; src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/decisions.json d-089)

The specification covers the amend, cancel amendment, delete notification and party edit pages the service serves, each with its heading, its fields and its messages (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/journey-spec.json:711-1100)

The specification's overview, page order, address picker, notification list and status strip entries read as the service serves those pages and behaviours (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/journey-spec.json:92, 105, 148, 154, 740-756)

Each of the specification's page, obligation and behaviour entries reads the same as the page, obligation or behaviour the service serves, checked entry by entry against the journey (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/journey-spec.json:740-1100)

rows.notes: Existing row inc-278 kept on this re-distil. This draft carries only req-2482, the specification slice from this area; inc-278 also holds req-2485 (the set's docs-folder guides) from the plants-set-docs area, whose draft carries the guide criteria (README, features, journey flow and gates, copy status, and the docs-change-with-behaviour rule). The combiner keeps both in inc-278, as before: the specification and the guides describe one journey and are checked against one walk of it. One slice: the specification is one document and its entries are read together. c-447 adds Copy as new on the view header and in the post-submission actions behaviour, and settles the copied-banner disagreement (repo-plantsfrontend-p15-080-m1) in favour of the banner. The overview, page order and Copy as new are built by the overview-and-review, consignment-parties and manage-notifications split themes, so this row reads them as served once those land: keep externalDependsOn shared/design-release-2-1/themes/manage-notifications inc-123. The consignor storage criterion records whichever storage the code keeps; it changes no behaviour. The picker entry already describes eight addresses a page with pagination beyond that and an inset naming the address chosen, which c-449 keeps. Depends on the rulings-records row, which re-stamps behaviour subjects in this same specification. The specification invents no Welsh wording for the pages and fields new to plants, which is its own standing rule.

splitOff.why: It adds Copy as new to the plants notification view header and its route, which theme manage-notifications builds; that pointer's pickUp already holds it.
